Prerequisites: —

You can expend up to your gambler level in MGP to conjure a single magical weapon, armor, or wondrous item with continuous or unlimited-use effects, worth up to 1,000 gil in price per MGP spent. The conjured item appears within 100 feet of you, lasts for 1 hour, and vanishes if its wielder or bearer moves beyond this range. If the conjured item is wearable or able to be wielded, you may conjure it directly onto a willing ally within range. When conjuring a magical weapon or armor, you may exchange enhancement bonuses for special abilities of equivalent value, but each item must have at least a +1 enhancement bonus. Ranged weapons created this way generate their normal ammunition automatically when used. Thrown ammunition is conjured in lots of 10.
